items.t: Rear axle seals leak gear oil onto the brakes
items.job: Replace rear axle seals (both sides), clean brakes and refill axle
items.note: Add parts and labor if the wheel bearings or soaked brake pads also need replacing.

items.t: Rear differential whine, grinding or failure
items.note: A used axle assembly costs less. Locking differentials cost more.

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifold ticking
items.job: Replace one exhaust manifold with gaskets and studs
items.note: Roughly double if both sides are cracked. Broken studs add time.

items.t: Radiator cracks and can mix coolant into the transmission
items.job: Replace radiator (and add external transmission cooler)
items.note: If coolant got into the transmission, a rebuilt transmission can add several thousand dollars.

items.t: Catalytic converters break up and damage the engine
items.note: If the cylinders are already scored, an engine replacement can cost $6,000 or more.

items.t: Timing chain whine from worn guides
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Often done along with the water pump and front seals.

items.t: Clicking behind the dash from blend door actuators
items.note: Labor depends on which actuator; some need dash parts removed.

items.t: Front brake judder and groaning
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: On-car resurfacing costs less if the rotors are thick enough.

items.t: Clunk or vibration from the driveshaft
items.job: Lubricate driveshaft slip yoke or replace U-joints

items.t: Knocking from cylinder 7 (scored cylinder wall)
items.note: Usually covered under the powertrain warranty when found in time.

items.t: Harsh shifts and shudder from the 7-speed automatic
items.job: Transmission software update or torque converter replacement
items.note: A software update alone is cheap; a torque converter job runs about $2,000-3,000.

items.t: Diesel turbo actuator failure and low power
items.job: Replace turbo actuator or high-pressure turbo
items.note: Covered by Nissan’s extended warranty for 10 years or 150,000 miles when a defect is confirmed.
